summary: Wave 3 Phase 2 backend testing complete. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_wave3_phase2.py with 14 pytest cases covering ONLY the new/changed endpoints (capabilities CRUD, featured flag, driver fleet CRUD, enhanced recommender, admin analytics overview). All 14/14 PASSED against http://localhost:8001 on first run. No blockers or minor issues found. Earlier waves not retested per request.
critical_code_review_comments: recommend-vehicle: when required_capabilities filters out ALL vehicles, the endpoint returns recommendations=[] (accepted per review spec). Consider a fallback to category defaults so the UI never shows an empty state — currently the UI would need its own empty-state message.

Admin PUT models (CategoryUpsert / VehicleUpsert / CapabilityUpsert) all require `name` even for partial updates (e.g. featured toggle). Frontend must always resend the name — safe today but a PATCH-style model would be cleaner.

Driver /api/driver/vehicles POST correctly enforces uniqueness of registration PER DRIVER only. Cross-driver duplicate registrations are allowed (may or may not be intentional — DVLA regs should be globally unique; if that's needed, add a global unique index).

is_default handling clears all other vehicles for the same driver on POST/PUT — correct. Note there is no server-side rule forcing at least one vehicle to be default after deletion of the current default; UI should surface this.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_w3p2_driver_* and TEST_w3p2_cust_* users registered per pytest module (via /auth/register). All admin catalog rows (capability, category-toggle, vehicle-toggle) and driver_vehicles rows created during tests are DELETED / restored in the same test using try/finally. No persistent seed data remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wave 3 Phase 2 backend endpoints (capabilities CRUD, featured flag on categories/vehicles, driver fleet CRUD, enhanced recommender with required_capabilities+reason, admin analytics overview) are all green. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_wave3_phase2.py for regression. Fixture pattern: body.get('access_token') or body.get('token'). vehicle_type_key 'lwb_van' resolves to vehicle_type_name 'Long Wheel Base Van'. Recommender returns empty recommendations[] when required_capabilities filters out all vehicles — not a fallback to category defaults.
